claim_text: The December 16, 2025 indictment in United States v. Sallah, No. 0:25-cr-00482 (ECF 1), alleges that Sallah diverted much of his fraud proceeds to conspirators including SafeLodgings employees and spent much of it on himself and on investments, including nearly $150,000 in a cryptocurrency exchange. That $150,000 is alleged proceeds diversion, not a Medicaid billed or paid figure and not an additional loss on top of the nearly $1.3 million allegedly received. Do not add it to first-wave HSS or to Feeding Our Future.

supporting_passages.quote: SALLAH diverted much of his fraud proceeds to conspirators, including to his employees at SafeLodgings, and he spent much of it on himself and on investments, including nearly $150,000 in a cryptocurrency exchange.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 22: nearly $150,000 in a cryptocurrency exchange. Alleged proceeds spending, overlapping the $1.3M received.
